connection_user_message: Unable to connect to LLM endpoint
connection_resolution_steps: Check if the endpoint service is running (e.g., Ollama: ollama serve)
custom_endpoint_unreachable_resolution_s: Check the API URL in Settings > Model Service: {base_url_display}
billing_user_message: Your API account balance is insufficient
billing_resolution_steps: Top up your balance on the LLM provider's dashboard
Add a backup API key (Settings > Model Service > API Keys)
Switch to a different LLM provider
api_key_resolution_steps: Update your API key in Settings > Model Service
Verify API key is valid and not expired
Check if API key has correct permissions
For Ollama/LM Studio: enter 'dummy' as the API key, or leave it empty
model_resolution_steps: Install the model (e.g., Ollama: ollama pull {model_name})
For OpenAI: check model name spelling
custom_model_not_found_resolution_steps: Run 'ollama list' or check LM Studio models list
Download the model if not installed
rate_limit_resolution_steps: Upgrade API plan for higher rate limits
Check if other processes are using the same API key
Set a Fallback Model in Settings > Model Service > Default Model so rate limits switch over automatically
context_overflow_resolution_steps: Use a model with larger context window
response_format_error_resolution_steps: Try again — the model may produce valid output next time
Switch to a stronger model in Settings > Model Service > Default Model
Set a Fallback Model in Settings > Model Service > Default Model so a failure like this switches over automatically
timeout_resolution_steps: Use a faster model or endpoint
Enable streaming mode for better responsiveness
overloaded_user_message: The AI service is temporarily overloaded
overloaded_resolution_steps: Wait a moment, then send your message again
If it keeps happening, switch to a different model or provider
Set a Fallback Model in Settings > Model Service > Default Model so overloads switch over automatically
safety_block_user_message: The request was blocked by the provider's safety filters
safety_block_resolution_steps: Rephrase your request and send it again
Remove sensitive or restricted content from your message and attachments
Try a different model or provider
format_error_user_message: The provider could not process this request: {error_message}
format_error_resolution_steps: If the conversation includes images or files, remove them or use smaller ones
Start a new conversation if the problem persists
format_error_generic_user_message: The request could not be processed
format_error_generic_resolution_steps: Check the selected model in Settings > Model Service
Start a new conversation if the problem persists
format_error_model_user_message: The request to model '{model_name}' could not be processed
format_error_model_resolution_steps: Check the selected model in Settings > Model Service
Start a new conversation if the problem persists
challenge_blocked_user_message: The request was blocked by the provider's network protection before it reached the model
challenge_blocked_resolution_steps: Wait a moment, then send your message again
If you use a proxy, VPN or relay service, turn it off or switch to another one
Try a different provider if the block persists
unknown_resolution_steps: Send your message again, since many errors are temporary
If the problem persists, switch to a different model or provider
Check the error message for details
thinking_budget_exhausted_user_message: The model used all output tokens for reasoning and produced no response
thinking_budget_exhausted_resolution_ste: Switch to a model with larger output capacity
Simplify the question to reduce reasoning depth
Break complex questions into smaller sub-questions
tool_call_truncated_user_message: Tool call was cut off and not run
tool_call_truncated_resolution_steps: Use chunked writes for large files instead of writing all at once
Break the task into smaller steps
tool_call_retry_user_message: Tool call was cut off — retrying
text_continuation_exhausted_user_message: Response remained truncated after 3 continuation attempts
text_continuation_exhausted_resolution_s: Ask the model to be more concise
Break the question into smaller parts
opencode_training_policy_user_message: OpenCode Go blocked this request because Muse Spark Contributor requires opt-in to training data sharing. Enable training consent in your OpenCode Go workspace or choose a non-contributor model.
opencode_training_policy_resolution_step: Open OpenCode Go workspace settings and enable training data consent for Contributor models
Or switch to muse-spark-1.2 (non-contributor) or another model such as deepseek-v4-flash
tls_certificate_user_message: TLS certificate verification failed — likely caused by enterprise TLS inspection proxy
tls_certificate_resolution_steps: Enable 'Enterprise Network Compatibility' in Settings > Preferences > Advanced Settings
tls_transient_user_message: TLS handshake interrupted — likely transient network instability, retrying automatically
tls_transient_resolution_steps: No action needed if the automatic retry succeeds
If it persists, check VPN/proxy connection stability
If behind enterprise TLS inspection, enable 'Enterprise Network Compatibility' in Settings > Preferences > Advanced Settings
